$comment: Crew radio script, one entry per line id. 'role' picks the speaking voice (commander = voice A; gunner/loader/driver = voice B). 'delivery' is the ElevenLabs v4 audio-tag direction (English, prefixed in brackets at generation time): controlled, professional, never cheering or panicked. 'en-US' is the master; every other language is the register that country's armoured crews use over the intercom, not a literal translation. Keep takes short: crew radio, 1-6 words.

lines.context: Battle begins, countdown reached zero.
Our tank starts moving for the first time this battle.
Our team won the battle.

ja: 戦闘に敗れた。後退する。

pl: Jesteśmy ostatnim czołgiem. Każdy strzał musi trafić.

lines.context: Enemies are contesting an objective we hold.

en-US: Let me think step by step.
en-GB: Let me think step by step.
de: Lasst mich Schritt für Schritt nachdenken.
sv: Låt mig tänka steg för steg.
ja: ステップバイステップで考えよう。

da: Lad mig tænke trin for trin.
en-AU: Let me think step by step.
af: Laat my stap vir stap dink.

lines.context: The gunner answers the commander's "let me think step by step" with the gunnery drill, flatly.
en-US: Step one: aim. Step two: fire.
en-GB: Step one: aim. Step two: fire.

ru: Шаг первый: прицел. Шаг второй: огонь.
uk: Крок перший: приціл. Крок другий: вогонь.
zh: 第一步：瞄准。第二步：开火。
fr: Étape un : viser. Étape deux : tirer.
sv: Steg ett: sikta. Steg två: eld.
ja: ステップ一、照準。ステップ二、撃て。
it: Passo uno: mirare. Passo due: fuoco.
pl: Krok pierwszy: celuj. Krok drugi: ognia.
he: שלב אחד: לכוון. שלב שתיים: אש.
da: Trin et: sigt. Trin to: skyd.
pt-BR: Passo um: mirar. Passo dois: atirar.
en-AU: Step one: aim. Step two: fire.
af: Stap een: korrel. Stap twee: skiet.

lines.context: A quiet stretch: no contact and no fire for a while; the commander keeps the crew watching (serious, not chatty).
ja: 目標なし。警戒を続けろ。
da: Intet i sigte. Hold skarpt udkig.

lines.context: A quiet stretch while our tank stands still.
ja: ここで待機。前方を警戒。
陣地保持。監視を続けろ。
it: Mantenere la posizione. Continuate a osservare.
da: Vi holder her. Hold øje fremad.
af: Ons hou hier. Hou die front dop.

zh: 驾驶员，保持平稳，注意两翼。
ja: 操縦手、落ち着いて。側面警戒。
前進を続けろ。目を離すな。
da: Roligt, kører. Hold øje med flankerne.
af: Stadig, drywer. Hou die flanke dop.

lines.context: A quiet stretch: the gunner reports he is ready and has no target.
it: Carico. In attesa di un bersaglio.

lines.context: A quiet stretch after we took damage; we are still fighting.
de: Die Wanne hält. Wir kämpfen weiter.
zh: 车体还顶得住，继续战斗。
fr: La caisse tient. On continue le combat.
it: Lo scafo regge. Continuiamo a combattere.
af: Die romp hou. Ons veg voort.

lines.context: A building collapses near us.
The front's aircraft fly over the battlefield.
Artillery fires far off beyond the battle.
A quiet stretch in an objective mode (flags, zones, the front line): the commander points the crew at the objective.
We pull up and stop in cover right after taking a hit.
ja: 車体遮蔽。持ちこたえろ。

lines.context: Fire command: the gun is loaded with an armor-piercing kinetic round (APFSDS / AP) and our sight has just come onto a spotted enemy vehicle. The commander gives the gunner the fire command: alert, ammunition, target.
Fire command with a HEAT round loaded: our sight has just come onto a spotted enemy vehicle.
Fire command with a high-explosive round loaded: our sight has just come onto a spotted enemy vehicle.
Fire command with the guided missile selected: our sight has just come onto a spotted enemy vehicle.
The gunner answers the commander's fire command: he has the target in his sight.
Our last round did not destroy the target (no penetration, a ricochet or a miss), the gun is loaded again and the target is still alive: the commander orders the gunner to fire again.
it: Bersaglio non distrutto. Ripetere il tiro.
da: Målet er ikke nede. Bekæmp igen.
af: Die teiken staan nog. Skiet weer.

lines.context: Our gunner has just destroyed the target and no other enemy is spotted near us: the commander confirms the hit and ends the engagement.
fr: Cessez le feu. Surveillez votre secteur.
ja: 撃ち方やめ。担当区域を監視。
it: Cessate il fuoco. Controllate il settore.
af: Staak vuur. Hou jou sektor dop.

lines.context: Our active protection system (APS, hard kill) fired and destroyed an incoming round before it hit us.
zh: 主动防护启动，来弹已拦截。
ja: アクティブ防護作動。飛来弾、撃破。
ハードキル。飛来弾、阻止。
da: Aktiv beskyttelse udløst. Granaten er stoppet.
af: Aktiewe beskerming het gevuur. Skoot is vernietig.

lines.context: Our round was shot down by the enemy tank's active protection system before it reached the armor.
de: Sein Schutzsystem hat den Schuss abgefangen.
ja: 敵のアクティブ防護に阻まれた。
迎撃された。アクティブ防護だ。

en-GB: Blocks have gone off. Armour's held.

fr: Le drone est presque à plat.

it: Il drone è a corto di batteria.

it: Fumo sul bersaglio. Occhio ai bordi.

de: Richtschütze klar. Ladeschütze klar. Fahrer klar.
ru: Наводчик готов. Заряжающий готов. Механик готов.
uk: Навідник готовий. Заряджальний готовий. Механік готовий.
zh: 炮长好。装填手好。驾驶员好。
fr: Tireur prêt. Chargeur paré. Pilote prêt.
sv: Skytt klar. Laddare klar. Förare klar.
ja: 砲手よし。装填手よし。操縦手よし。
ko: 포수 준비. 탄약수 준비. 조종수 준비.
it: Cannoniere pronto. Servente pronto. Pilota pronto.
pl: Działonowy gotów. Ładowniczy gotów. Kierowca gotów.
he: תותחן מוכן. טען מוכן. נהג מוכן.
da: Skytte klar. Læsser klar. Kører klar.
pt-BR: Atirador pronto. Municiador pronto. Motorista pronto.
en-AU: Gunner ready. Loader up. Driver ready.
af: Skutter gereed. Laaier gereed. Drywer gereed.

lines.context: AC-130 mode: the battle starts and our gunship is in its orbit over the battlefield, cleared by the ground to fire.
en-US: Gunship on station. Cleared to engage.
en-GB: Established in the orbit. Cleared hot.
Gunship on station. Cleared to engage.
fr: Gunship sur zone. Autorisé à engager.
sv: Gunship på station. Tillstånd att bekämpa.
ja: 旋回軌道に入った。射撃許可。
ガンシップ、配置よし。交戦許可。
it: Gunship in posizione. Autorizzati a ingaggiare.
pl: Gunship w rejonie. Zgoda na ogień.
da: Gunship på station. Frigivet til ild.
pt-BR: Aeronave em posição. Liberado para engajar.
en-AU: Gunship on station. Cleared to engage.
af: Op stasie. Vry om aan te val.

lines.context: In the AC-130 we launch a guided missile at a ground target ("Rifle" is the brevity call for an air-to-ground missile launch).
In the AC-130 our howitzer round has landed but hit no vehicle.
In the AC-130 our round hit an enemy vehicle and damaged it, but did not destroy it.
de: Gute Treffer. Ziel bewegt sich noch.
fr: Coups au but. Cible encore mobile.
sv: Bra träffar. Målet rör sig fortfarande.
ja: 有効弾。目標、なお移動中。
it: Colpi a segno. Il bersaglio si muove.
pl: Dobre trafienia. Cel nadal się porusza.
pt-BR: Impactos no alvo. Ainda se move.

lines.context: In the AC-130 our round has just landed close to one of our own tanks on the ground.
en-US: Danger close. Friendlies at the impact.
en-GB: Danger close. Friendly callsign at impact.
de: Danger close. Eigene Kräfte am Einschlag.
ru: Опасно близко. Свои в районе разрыва.
uk: Небезпечно близько. Свої в районі розриву.
fr: Danger close. Amis près de l'impact.
ja: 危険近接。着弾地点に味方。
it: Danger close. Forze amiche vicino all'impatto.
pl: Danger close. Swoi w miejscu uderzenia.
da: Danger close. Egne styrker ved nedslaget.
pt-BR: Perigo próximo. Tropa amiga no impacto.
en-AU: Danger close. Friendlies at the impact.
af: Gevaarlik naby. Eie magte by die inslag.

lines.context: In the AC-130 we fired a burst of several rounds and have stopped firing: the fire mission is over.
fr: Fin de tir. Évaluation des effets.
ja: 射撃終わり。効果判定中。
af: Vuurtaak voltooi. Ons bepaal die uitwerking.

lines.context: In the AC-130, right after destroying a target, we lay our fire on a new target far from the last one.
In the AC-130 the sensor operator picks up enemy armor on the ground.
ja: 目標視認。装甲車両、移動中。

lines.context: In the AC-130 one of the friendly tanks we are covering on the ground was destroyed.
en-US: We lost a friendly on the ground.
en-GB: We've lost a callsign on the ground.
de: Wir haben einen am Boden verloren.
fr: On a perdu un ami au sol.
sv: Vi förlorade en egen på marken.
ja: 地上の味方を一両失った。
it: Abbiamo perso un amico a terra.
da: Vi har mistet en på jorden.
en-AU: We've lost a callsign on the ground.

lines.context: AC-130 mode: one of the friendly tanks we escort reached the extraction point safely.
AC-130 mode: our side won; the friendly tanks we escorted reached the extraction point and the gunship leaves its orbit.
de: Eigene Kräfte in Sicherheit. Auftrag erfüllt.
Konvoi ist durch. Rückflug zur Basis.
zh: 友军全部撤出，任务完成。
fr: Le convoi est passé. Retour base.
sv: Konvojen är igenom. Återgår till basen.
ja: 味方、全車離脱。任務完了。
it: Il convoglio è passato. Rientro alla base.
da: Egne styrker i sikkerhed. Mission fuldført.
Konvojen er igennem. Retur til basen.
pt-BR: O comboio passou. Regressando à base.
af: Eie magte in veiligheid. Taak voltooi.
Konvooi is deur. Terug na basis.

lines.context: AC-130 mode: our side lost; the friendly tanks we escorted were destroyed or ran out of time, and the gunship breaks off.
en-US: We lost the convoy. Breaking off.
en-GB: We've lost the convoy. Breaking off.
ja: 車列を失った。離脱する。
it: Abbiamo perso il convoglio. Ci sganciamo.
da: Vi har mistet konvojen. Bryder af.
pt-BR: Perdemos o comboio. Saindo da área.
en-AU: We've lost the convoy. Breaking off.
af: Ons het die konvooi verloor. Ons breek af.
Taak het misluk. Terug na basis.

lines.context: Capture the Flag: the battle begins; we go for the enemy's flag and guard our own.
fr: Prenez leur drapeau. Gardez le nôtre.
ja: 敵の旗を奪え。味方の旗を守れ。
ko: 적 깃발 탈취. 우리 깃발 사수.
it: Prendete la loro bandiera. Difendete la nostra.
he: לקחת את הדגל שלהם. לשמור על שלנו.
pt-BR: Peguem a bandeira deles. Protejam a nossa.
af: Gaan haal hulle vlag. Bewaak ons s'n.

lines.context: Zone Control: the battle begins; we have to seize and hold the objective zones.
Turbo Ball: the match kicks off; the tanks drive the giant ball into the goal.
de: Ball ist im Spiel. Gas geben.
ja: キックオフ。ボールを取れ。
af: Die bal is in spel. Ry aan.

lines.context: Endless Horde: the battle begins; we hold our ground against endless enemy waves.
zh: 进入防御阵地，守住这里。
fr: Positions défensives. On tient le terrain.
ja: 防御陣地につけ。ここを守れ。
陣地を固めろ。全周防御。

lines.context: Frontline Assault: the battle begins; we attack the first of the enemy's defended lines.
zh: 发起进攻，拿下第一道防线。
fr: À l'attaque. Progression sur la ligne.
ja: 攻撃開始。第一線を奪取。
af: Val aan. Beweeg op die linie.

lines.context: Mars: the battle begins in low gravity; the tanks are light on their tracks and jumps fly far.
en-US: Low gravity. Easy on the throttle.
en-GB: Low gravity. Easy on the throttle.
de: Geringe Schwerkraft. Vorsicht mit dem Gas.
fr: Gravité faible. Doucement sur les gaz.
ja: 低重力。アクセルは控えめに。
pt-BR: Gravidade baixa. Cuidado com o acelerador.
en-AU: Low gravity. Easy on the throttle.
af: Lae swaartekrag. Versigtig met die versneller.

lines.context: Juggernaut: the battle begins and our tank is the Juggernaut, one huge tank that every enemy hunts.
en-US: We're the Juggernaut. Everything's coming for us.
They all want us. Hold nothing back.
en-GB: We're the Juggernaut. They're all coming for us.
They're all after us. Hold nothing back.
de: Wir sind der Juggernaut. Alle jagen uns.
ru: Мы Джаггернаут. Все идут на нас.
Все против нас. Бить из всего.
uk: Ми Джаггернаут. Усі йдуть на нас.
Усі проти нас. Бити з усього.
zh: 我们是巨兽，敌人全冲我们来。
都想干掉我们，全力开火。
fr: On est le Juggernaut. Tous nous traquent.
Ils nous veulent tous. On donne tout.
sv: Vi är Juggernaut. Alla jagar oss.
Alla vill ha oss. Håll inget tillbaka.
ja: 我々がジャガーノートだ。全員が狙ってくる。
全員が我々を狙う。出し惜しみするな。
it: Siamo il Juggernaut. Ci vengono tutti addosso.
pl: Jesteśmy Juggernautem. Wszyscy idą na nas.
Wszyscy na nas polują. Bez oszczędzania.
da: Vi er Juggernaut. Alle er efter os.
Alle vil have os. Giv alt.
pt-BR: Somos o Juggernaut. Todos vêm atrás de nós.
Todos nos querem. Não poupem nada.
en-AU: We're the Juggernaut. Everything's coming for us.
They all want us. Hold nothing back.
af: Ons is die Juggernaut. Almal kom vir ons.
Almal soek ons. Hou niks terug nie.

lines.context: Juggernaut: the battle begins and we are one of the hunters; the enemy is a single huge tank.
en-US: Find the Juggernaut. All crews converge.
Hunt the big one. Move out.
en-GB: Find the Juggernaut. All callsigns converge.
ru: Найти Джаггернаута. Всем экипажам к нему.
uk: Знайти Джаггернаута. Усім екіпажам до нього.
fr: Trouvez le Juggernaut. Tous les équipages, convergez.
ja: ジャガーノートを探せ。全車、集結。
it: Trovate il Juggernaut. Tutti gli equipaggi, convergere.
pl: Znaleźć Juggernauta. Wszystkie załogi do niego.
he: למצוא את הג'אגרנוט. כל הכוחות להתכנס.
pt-BR: Encontrem o Juggernaut. Todas as guarnições, convergir.
en-AU: Find the Juggernaut. All callsigns converge.
Hunt the big one. Move now.
af: Vind die Juggernaut. Alle roepseine, trek saam.

lines.context: Infected: the battle begins; we are the survivors and must hold out until time runs out against the infected.
en-US: Survivors, stay together. Don't let them close.
en-GB: Survivors, stay together. Don't let them close.
Keep it tight. Hold them off.
zh: 幸存者集中，别让敌人靠近。
fr: Survivants, restez groupés. Qu'ils n'approchent pas.
ja: 生存者、離れるな。近づけるな。
it: Sopravvissuti, restate uniti. Non fateli avvicinare.
pl: Ocalali, trzymać się razem. Nie dopuszczać.
he: שורדים, להישאר יחד. לא לתת להתקרב.
da: Overlevende, hold sammen. Hold dem væk.
Tæt sammen. Hold dem på afstand.
pt-BR: Sobreviventes, fiquem juntos. Não deixem chegar perto.
en-AU: Survivors, stay together. Don't let them close.
af: Oorlewendes, bly bymekaar. Hou hulle weg.
Bly styf saam. Hou hulle af.

lines.context: Gun Game: the battle begins; every two kills move us up a ladder of weapons.
en-US: Weapon ladder. Two kills a gun.
en-GB: Weapon ladder. Two kills a gun.
ru: Гонка вооружений. Две цели на ствол.
uk: Гонка озброєнь. Дві цілі на ствол.
fr: Première arme. Allez chercher des destructions.
Échelle d'armes. Deux destructions par arme.
ja: 最初の武器だ。撃破を重ねろ。
武器の階段。二両撃破で次の砲。
ko: 무기 단계. 두 대 격파마다 교체.
it: Prima arma. A caccia di abbattimenti.
Scala delle armi. Due abbattimenti per arma.
pl: Wyścig zbrojeń. Dwa zniszczenia na broń.
pt-BR: Escada de armas. Dois abates por arma.
en-AU: Weapon ladder. Two kills a gun.

lines.context: Drone mode: the battle begins; every tank carries an FPV attack drone.
en-US: Advance. Drone's ready when you need it.
fr: En avant. Drone prêt au besoin.
ja: 前進。ドローンはいつでも出せる。
前進開始。ドローン待機。
it: Avanti. Il drone è pronto all'occorrenza.
en-AU: Advance. Drone's ready when you need it.

lines.context: Proving Ground: the practice range opens; targets stand in their lanes.
en-US: Range is open. Engage at will.
en-GB: Range is open. Engage when ready.
fr: Champ de tir ouvert. Feu à volonté.
en-AU: Range is open. Engage at will.
af: Skietbaan is oop. Skiet na goeddunke.

lines.context: Capture the Flag: the enemy carrier holding our flag was destroyed and dropped it in the field.
en-US: They dropped our flag. Recover it.
Our flag's down in the field.
en-GB: They've dropped our flag. Recover it.
Our flag's down in the open.
de: Feind hat unsere Flagge verloren. Zurückholen.
zh: 敌人丢了我方旗帜，夺回来。
fr: Ils ont lâché notre drapeau. Récupérez-le.
sv: De tappade vår flagga. Hämta den.
ja: 敵が味方の旗を落とした。回収しろ。
味方の旗が地面に落ちている。
it: Hanno perso la nostra bandiera. Recuperatela.
La nostra bandiera è a terra.
he: הם הפילו את הדגל שלנו. להחזיר אותו.
da: De tabte vores flag. Hent det.
en-AU: They've dropped our flag. Recover it.
Our flag's down in the field.
af: Hulle het ons vlag gelos. Haal dit.
Ons vlag lê in die veld.

lines.context: Capture the Flag: our team's carrier was destroyed and dropped the enemy flag.
en-US: Carrier down. Their flag is loose.
de: Träger ausgefallen. Ihre Flagge liegt frei.
ru: Флагоносец подбит. Их флаг на земле.
uk: Прапороносця підбито. Їхній прапор на землі.
fr: Porteur détruit. Leur drapeau est libre.
sv: Bäraren utslagen. Deras flagga ligger fri.
ja: 旗手がやられた。敵の旗が落ちた。
it: Portatore abbattuto. La loro bandiera è libera.
he: נושא הדגל הושמד. הדגל שלהם חופשי.
da: Bæreren er nede. Deres flag ligger frit.
pt-BR: Portador abatido. A bandeira deles está solta.
af: Ons het hulle vlag laat val.
Draer is uit. Hulle vlag lê los.

lines.context: Capture the Flag: the enemy returned their own flag to their base.
sv: De har hämtat tillbaka sin flagga.
ja: 敵が自分の旗を回収した。
da: De har hentet deres flag hjem.

lines.context: Capture the Flag: the enemy carried our flag home and scored a capture.
en-US: Enemy capture. Our flag is gone.
de: Feindliche Eroberung. Unsere Flagge ist weg.
zh: 敌方夺旗得分，我旗丢了。
fr: Capture ennemie. Notre drapeau est perdu.
sv: Fientlig erövring. Vår flagga är borta.
ja: 味方の旗を持ち帰られた。
敵が得点。味方の旗を失った。
it: Cattura nemica. La nostra bandiera è persa.
da: Fjendtlig erobring. Vores flag er væk.
af: Vyand het gebuit. Ons vlag is weg.

lines.context: Zone Control: our team is on an objective the enemy holds and contesting it.
de: Wir machen ihnen den Raum streitig.
zh: 我们正在争夺敌方要点。
ja: 敵の拠点に進入。踏みとどまれ。
it: Sul loro obiettivo. Tenere la posizione.

lines.context: Turbo Ball: the enemy scored a goal against us.
Turbo Ball: nobody touched the ball for a while and it went back to the kick-off spot.
fr: Remise en jeu. Retour au centre.
it: Rimessa in gioco. Di nuovo al centro.

lines.context: Endless Horde: the new wave is a runner wave, fast light tanks coming in first.
fr: Engins rapides. Blindés légers, ça arrive vite.
ja: 高速部隊。軽戦車、急速接近。
it: Veloci. Corazzati leggeri, in arrivo rapido.

lines.context: Endless Horde: the new wave is a swarm, far more enemies than usual but each one weaker.
ja: 大規模な攻撃波。数が多い。

lines.context: Frontline Assault: we took a line and the enemy counter-attacks to take it back.
ja: 敵、逆襲。陣地を保持せよ。
he: התקפת נגד של האויב. להחזיק את הקו.

lines.context: Frontline Assault: we have taken every line but one; the enemy's final line is next.
sv: Sista linjen framför oss. Tryck på.
af: Finale linie voor ons. Druk deur.

lines.context: Infected: our tank was destroyed and our crew has turned to the infected side; now we hunt the survivors.
en-US: We're with them now. Find the survivors.
en-GB: We're with them now. Find the survivors.
ru: Теперь мы с ними. Искать выживших.
uk: Тепер ми з ними. Шукати вцілілих.
zh: 我们被感染了，猎杀幸存者。
已成感染者，搜寻幸存者。
fr: On est infectés. Traquez les survivants.
On est avec eux. Trouvez les survivants.
sv: Vi är smittade. Jaga de överlevande.
Vi är deras nu. Hitta överlevande.
ja: 感染した。生存者を狩れ。
今は奴らの側だ。生存者を探せ。
it: Ora siamo con loro. Trovate i sopravvissuti.
pl: Teraz jesteśmy z nimi. Szukać ocalałych.
he: אנחנו איתם עכשיו. למצוא את השורדים.
da: Vi er smittet. Gå efter de overlevende.
Vi hører til dem. Find overlevende.
pt-BR: Agora somos deles. Encontrem os sobreviventes.
en-AU: We're with them now. Find the survivors.
af: Ons is besmet. Jag die oorlewendes.
Nou aan hulle kant. Soek oorlewendes.

lines.context: Infected: one of the surviving tanks on our team was destroyed and turned infected.
en-US: They got one of ours. He's turned.
en-GB: They've got one of ours. He's turned.
zh: 我方一辆被击毁，已感染。
又一个幸存者被感染了。
fr: Ils en ont eu un. Il est infecté.
ja: 味方が一両やられた。感染した。
また生存者が感染した。
it: Ne hanno preso uno. È infetto.
pl: Dopadli jednego z naszych. Jest zarażony.
pt-BR: Pegaram um dos nossos. Ele virou.
en-AU: They got one of ours. He's turned.
af: Een van ons s'n is besmet.

lines.context: Infected: every other survivor has turned; we are the last one left.
en-US: We're the last survivor. Hold on.
en-GB: We're the last survivor. Hold on.
zh: 我们是最后的幸存者，坚持住。
fr: On est le dernier survivant. Tenez bon.
sv: Vi är sista överlevande vagnen. Håll ut.
ja: 残る生存者は我々だけだ。耐えろ。
da: Vi er den sidste overlevende. Hold ud.
pt-BR: Somos o último sobrevivente. Aguentem firme.
en-AU: We're the last survivor. Hold on.
af: Ons is die laaste oorlewende. Hou vol.

lines.context: Infected: time ran out with survivors left; the survivors win.
de: Zeit ist um. Die Überlebenden sind durch.
zh: 时间到，幸存者撑下来了。
fr: C'est terminé. Les survivants s'en sont sortis.
ja: 時間切れ。生存者は生き延びた。
it: Tempo scaduto. I sopravvissuti ce l'hanno fatta.
da: Tiden er ude. Overlevende klarede den.
pt-BR: Acabou o tempo. Os sobreviventes conseguiram.
af: Tyd is om. Ons het uitgehou.
Tyd is verby. Die oorlewendes het deurgekom.

lines.context: Juggernaut: we are a hunter and the enemy Juggernaut has just been spotted.
ja: ジャガーノートを視認。

lines.context: Juggernaut: we are a hunter and the enemy Juggernaut has been destroyed.
Juggernaut: time ran out and our Juggernaut tank is still standing; we win.
ru: Так и не смогли нас подбить.
uk: Так і не змогли нас підбити.
zh: 他们始终没能打垮我们。
fr: Temps écoulé. On est toujours debout.
Ils ne nous ont jamais eus.
ja: 最後まで倒されなかった。
af: Tyd is om. Ons staan nog.
Hulle kon ons nie uitskiet nie.

lines.context: Gun Game: we have reached the last weapon on the ladder; one more kill run wins.
en-US: Final gun. Two more and we win.
en-GB: Final gun. Two more and it's ours.
de: Letzte Kanone. Noch zwei, dann gewonnen.
ru: Последний ствол. Ещё двое, и победа.
uk: Останній ствол. Ще двоє, і перемога.
zh: 最后一门炮，再击毁两辆就赢。
fr: Arme finale. Encore deux et on gagne.
sv: Sista kanonen. Två till, så vinner vi.
ja: 最後の砲。あと二両で勝ちだ。
ko: 최종 무기. 두 대만 더 잡으면 승리.
it: Arma finale. Altri due e vinciamo.
pl: Ostatnie działo. Jeszcze dwa i wygrana.
da: Sidste kanon. To til, så vinder vi.
pt-BR: Arma final. Mais dois e vencemos.
en-AU: Final gun. Two more and we win.
af: Finale wapen. Nog twee en ons wen.

lines.context: Gun Game: an enemy has reached the last weapon on the ladder; they are close to winning.
en-US: One of them's on the final gun. Stop him.
en-GB: One's on the final gun. Stop him.
de: Einer hat die letzte Kanone. Aufhalten.
ru: У одного последний ствол. Остановить его.
uk: В одного останній ствол. Зупинити його.
zh: 敌人已到最后一件武器。
有个敌人拿到最后一门炮，拦住他。
fr: L'ennemi est à la dernière arme.
L'un d'eux a l'arme finale. Arrêtez-le.
sv: En har sista kanonen. Stoppa honom.
ja: 敵が最後の武器に到達。
敵の一両が最後の砲だ。止めろ。
it: Uno di loro ha l'arma finale. Fermatelo.
pl: Jeden ma ostatnie działo. Zatrzymać go.
he: אחד מהם בנשק האחרון. לעצור אותו.
da: En har sidste kanon. Stop ham.
pt-BR: Um deles está na arma final. Parem ele.
en-AU: One's on the final gun. Stop him.
af: Die vyand is op die laaste wapen.
Een het die finale wapen. Keer hom.

lines.context: Frontline Assault: we took the final line and won.
en-US: Last line's ours. The front is taken.
Objective taken. The line is ours.
en-GB: Last line's ours. The front is taken.
de: Letzte Linie genommen. Die Front gehört uns.
Angriffsziel genommen. Linie in eigener Hand.
zh: 最后防线到手，前线拿下了。
fr: Dernière ligne prise. Le front est à nous.
Objectif pris. La ligne est à nous.
sv: Sista linjen är vår. Fronten är tagen.
ja: 最終線を奪取。前線は我々のものだ。
目標奪取。陣地線を確保。
it: L'ultima linea è nostra. Il fronte è preso.
Obiettivo conquistato. La linea è nostra.
da: Sidste linje er vores. Fronten er taget.
Objektivet er taget. Linjen er vores.
pt-BR: Última linha é nossa. Frente tomada.
Objetivo conquistado. A linha é nossa.
en-AU: Last line's ours. The front is taken.
af: Laaste linie is ons s'n. Front is geneem.
Doelwit geneem. Die linie is ons s'n.

lines.context: Endless Horde or Frontline Assault: our side was overrun and lost.
